svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 02/12 Scripps Pier (Rare)
svg.desc: A long research pier walking straight out into the Pacific. The pelicans treat it as theirs. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
